title: F4 skeptic: Beaufort substitution alone, KRYPTOS-only key
hypothesis_summary: Skeptic-minimal counterpart to F4-41. The KRYPTOS-distance anomaly (E0b) supports a keyword-mixed substitution near KRYPTOS but does NOT inherently require a transposition layer. This pack tests Beaufort substitution alone with KRYPTOS as the only keyword. If F4-41 outperforms this floor, the columnar layer earned its keep; if not, the proponent reading is over-fit.

provenance_items.quote_or_summary: Anomaly E0b: KRYPTOS-set cipher distances cluster near identity. Bean 2021 §2.4.
KRYPTOS is the K1-K3 alphabet keyword.

composition_templates.rationale: Single-keyword fallback path: KRYPTOS in both sub and columnar slot for the i3 single-keyword degenerate emit.

constraints: KRYPTOS-only keyword pool — single-keyword fallback in the i3 emitter.
caveats: Within the bridge compiler the only Beaufort-substitution-bearing emitters require a transposition partner; this pack uses the single-keyword fallback for sub+columnar with KRYPTOS in both roles. The 'Beaufort alone' claim is approximated, not exact.
